description: This file defines the OrderTotal class, representing a financial total associated with an order in the sales management system. It includes properties such as title, code, order, module, and value, along with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: Entity class representing total amounts related to an order, including titles, codes, modules, and monetary values.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the order total.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the order total.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code associated with the order total.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code associated with the order total.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order value (integer for sorting or referencing).

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with this total.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the monetary value of the total.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the monetary value of the total.
